social_post_delivery.value:
("social_posts"."draft_id" is null and "social_posts"."delivery" is null and "social_posts"."schedule_id" is null and "social_posts"."repeat_number" = 0)
    or ("social_posts"."draft_id" is not null and "social_posts"."delivery" is not null and jsonb_typeof("social_posts"."delivery") = 'object'
      and octet_length("social_posts"."delivery"::text) <= 70000 and "social_posts"."media" = '[]'::jsonb and "social_posts"."repeat_number" between 0 and 52)

social_post_content.name: social_post_content
social_post_content.value: (("social_posts"."draft_id" is null and length("social_posts"."content") between 1 and 10000) or ("social_posts"."draft_id" is not null and length("social_posts"."content") <= 100000)) and jsonb_typeof("social_posts"."media") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("social_posts"."media") <= 10 and octet_length("social_posts"."media"::text) <= 8192

social_post_state_shape.name: social_post_state_shape
social_post_state_shape.value:
("social_posts"."status" <> 'scheduled' or ("social_posts"."scheduled_for" is not null and "social_posts"."next_attempt_at" is not null and "social_posts"."lock_token" is null and "social_posts"."locked_at" is null))
    and ("social_posts"."status" <> 'publishing' or ("social_posts"."first_attempt_at" is not null and (("social_posts"."lock_token" is not null and "social_posts"."locked_at" is not null) or ("social_posts"."lock_token" is null and "social_posts"."locked_at" is null and "social_posts"."provider_post_ref" is not null and "social_posts"."next_attempt_at" is not null))))
    and ("social_posts"."status" = 'publishing' or ("social_posts"."lock_token" is null and "social_posts"."locked_at" is null))
    and ("social_posts"."status" <> 'scheduled' or "social_posts"."provider_post_ref" is null)
    and ("social_posts"."status" <> 'published' or ("social_posts"."provider_post_ref" is not null and "social_posts"."published_at" is not null))
    and ("social_posts"."status" <> 'failed' or "social_posts"."last_error_code" is not null)

social_schedule_shape.name: social_schedule_shape
social_schedule_shape.value:
length("social_schedules"."name") between 1 and 120 and length("social_schedules"."timezone") between 1 and 80
    and jsonb_typeof("social_schedules"."slots") = 'array' and jsonb_array_length("social_schedules"."slots") between 1 and 84 and "social_schedules"."version" > 0

social_webhook_fields.name: social_webhook_fields
social_webhook_fields.value: length("social_webhook_events"."provider_event_id") between 1 and 200 and length("social_webhook_events"."event_type") between 1 and 100 and length("social_webhook_events"."external_account_ref") between 1 and 200 and ("social_webhook_events"."subject_ref" is null or length("social_webhook_events"."subject_ref") between 1 and 200)

user_profile_city_region.name: user_profile_city_region
user_profile_city_region.value: "user_profiles"."city_region" is null or length("user_profiles"."city_region") between 1 and 200

volunteer_request_kind.name: volunteer_request_kind
volunteer_request_kind.value: (("volunteer_requests"."kind" = 'swap' and "volunteer_requests"."replacement_user_id" <> "volunteer_requests"."user_id") or "volunteer_requests"."kind" = 'decline') and ("volunteer_requests"."kind" = 'swap') = ("volunteer_requests"."replacement_user_id" is not null)

volunteer_slot_details.name: volunteer_slot_details
volunteer_slot_details.value: length(btrim("volunteer_slots"."title")) between 1 and 120 and "volunteer_slots"."needed" between 1 and 500 and "volunteer_slots"."ends_at" > "volunteer_slots"."starts_at"

workspace_invitation_status.name: workspace_invitation_status
workspace_invitation_status.value: "workspace_invitations"."status" in ('pending','accepted','revoked') and (("workspace_invitations"."status" = 'pending') = ("workspace_invitations"."responded_at" is null)) and (("workspace_invitations"."status" = 'accepted') = ("workspace_invitations"."accepted_by" is not null))
